svg.data-hit-testing: Use visible path geometry, not group bounding rectangles; apply viewBox 100 0 1360 1190 with xMidYMid meet.
svg.title: CutLink Australian goat cuts
svg.desc: Select a cut to see its sub-cuts. Quarter selections are commercial groupings; boundaries are illustrative. SVG paths only, no embedded raster. Embed inline or as an object to enable events.
